name: Dazzle
description: Photo-memory MCP server that turns a user's synced camera roll into personal context, so agents can answer questions about their trips, people, style and habits with photos.

skills.name: Ask About Your Life
skills.description: Ask any question about the user's own life and get an answer drawn from their photos, plus the matching photos.

skills.name: Find Matching Photos
skills.description: Return recent photos that match a description or category, for tasks like food tracking or journaling.
